verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā ānando …pe… bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: And then Venerable Ānanda … said to the Buddha:
“Sir, they say that ‘the world is empty’.

verses.pali: Kittāvatā nu kho, bhante, suñño lokoti vuccatī”ti?
verses.english: What does the saying ‘the world is empty’ refer to?”

verses.pali: “Yasmā ca kho, ānanda, suññaṁ attena vā attaniyena vā tasmā suñño lokoti vuccati.
verses.english: “Ānanda, they say that ‘the world is empty’ because it’s empty of self or what belongs to self.

verses.pali: Kiñca, ānanda, suññaṁ attena vā attaniyena vā?
verses.english: And what is empty of self or what belongs to self?

verses.pali: Cakkhu kho, ānanda, suññaṁ attena vā attaniyena vā.
Rūpā suññā attena vā attaniyena vā, cakkhuviññāṇaṁ suññaṁ attena vā attaniyena vā, cakkhusamphasso suñño attena vā attaniyena vā …pe…
verses.english: sights, eye consciousness, and eye contact are empty of self or what belongs to self. …

verses.pali: yampidaṁ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṁ sukhaṁ vā dukkhaṁ vā adukkhamasukhaṁ vā tampi suññaṁ attena vā attaniyena vā.
verses.english: The pleasant, painful, or neutral feeling that arises dependent on mind contact is also empty of self or what belongs to self.

verses.pali: Yasmā ca kho, ānanda, suññaṁ attena vā attaniyena vā, tasmā suñño lokoti vuccatī”ti.
verses.english: They say that ‘the world is empty’ because it’s empty of self or what belongs to self.”
